import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.applications import EfficientNetB0
from tensorflow.keras.applications.efficientnet import preprocess_input
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model




train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")




base_model = EfficientNetB0(weights="imagenet", include_top=False, pooling="avg")
inp = tf.keras.Input(shape=(224,224,3))
x = preprocess_input(inp)
out = base_model(x)
img_model = Model(inp, out)

def extract_features(img_path):
    try:
        img = Image.open(f"data/{img_path}").convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize((224,224))
        arr = np.expand_dims(np.array(img),0)
        return img_model.predict(arr)[0]
    except:
        return np.zeros((img_model.output_shape[-1],))


train_imgs = np.vstack(train["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)
test_imgs  = np.vstack(test["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)





targets = train[["Dry_Green_g","Dry_Dead_g","Dry_Clover_g","GDM_g","Dry_Total_g"]]
train = train.drop(["Dry_Green_g","Dry_Dead_g","Dry_Clover_g","GDM_g","Dry_Total_g"],axis=1)


num_cols = ["Height_Ave_cm","Pre_GSHH_NDVI"]

cat_cols = ["State","Species"]


preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", "passthrough", num_cols),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_cols)
])


X_train = np.hstack([train_imgs, train[num_cols].values])
X_test  = np.hstack([test_imgs, test[num_cols].values])




X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, targets.values, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)




preds = {}
for i,col in enumerate(targets.columns):
    model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:,i])
    vpred = model.predict(X_val)
    print(f"{col} R2:", r2_score(y_val[:,i], vpred))
    preds[col] = model




submission = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": test["sample_id"]})

for col,model in preds.items():
    submission[col] = model.fit(X_train, targets[col].values).predict(X_test)


sub_long = submission.melt(id_vars="sample_id",var_name="target_name",value_name="target")
sub_long.to_csv("submission.csv",index=False)

print("✅ submission.csv created")
submission.head()

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.applications import EfficientNetB0
from tensorflow.keras.applications.efficientnet import preprocess_input
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model




train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")




base_model = EfficientNetB0(weights="imagenet", include_top=False, pooling="avg")
inp = tf.keras.Input(shape=(224,224,3))
x = preprocess_input(inp)
out = base_model(x)
img_model = Model(inp, out)

def extract_features(img_path):
    try:
        img = Image.open(f"data/{img_path}").convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize((224,224))
        arr = np.expand_dims(np.array(img),0)
        return img_model.predict(arr)[0]
    except:
        return np.zeros((img_model.output_shape[-1],))


train_imgs = np.vstack(train["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)
test_imgs  = np.vstack(test["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)





targets = train[["Dry_Green_g","Dry_Dead_g","Dry_Clover_g","GDM_g","Dry_Total_g"]]
train = train.drop(["Dry_Green_g","Dry_Dead_g","Dry_Clover_g","GDM_g","Dry_Total_g"],axis=1)


num_cols = ["Height_Ave_cm","Pre_GSHH_NDVI"]

cat_cols = ["State","Species"]


preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", "passthrough", num_cols),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_cols)
])


X_train = np.hstack([train_imgs, train[num_cols].values])
X_test  = np.hstack([test_imgs, test[num_cols].values])




X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, targets.values, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)




preds = {}
for i,col in enumerate(targets.columns):
    model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:,i])
    vpred = model.predict(X_val)
    print(f"{col} R2:", r2_score(y_val[:,i], vpred))
    preds[col] = model




submission = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": test["sample_id"]})

for col,model in preds.items():
    submission[col] = model.fit(X_train, targets[col].values).predict(X_test)


sub_long = submission.melt(id_vars="sample_id",var_name="target_name",value_name="target")
sub_long.to_csv("submission.csv",index=False)

print("✅ submission.csv created")

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.applications import EfficientNetB0
from tensorflow.keras.applications.efficientnet import preprocess_input
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model

train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

base_model = EfficientNetB0(weights="imagenet", include_top=False, pooling="avg")
inp = tf.keras.Input(shape=(224,224,3))
x = preprocess_input(inp)
out = base_model(x)
img_model = Model(inp, out)

def extract_features(img_path):
    try:
        img = Image.open(f"data/{img_path}").convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize((224,224))
        arr = np.expand_dims(np.array(img),0)
        return img_model.predict(arr)[0]
    except:
        return np.zeros((img_model.output_shape[-1],))

train_imgs = np.vstack(train["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)
test_imgs  = np.vstack(test["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)

# Detect target columns from train data - look for columns present in train but not in test
target_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in test.columns]
print(f"Target columns found: {target_cols}")

targets = train[target_cols]
train = train.drop(target_cols, axis=1)

# Detect numerical columns (exclude categorical and ID columns)
num_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["State", "Species", "image_path", "sample_id"]]
print(f"Numerical columns found: {num_cols}")

cat_cols = ["State", "Species"]

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", "passthrough", num_cols),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_cols)
])

X_train = np.hstack([train_imgs, train[num_cols].values])
X_test  = np.hstack([test_imgs, test[num_cols].values])

X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, targets.values, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

preds = {}
for i, col in enumerate(targets.columns):
    model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:,i])
    vpred = model.predict(X_val)
    print(f"{col} R2:", r2_score(y_val[:,i], vpred))
    preds[col] = model

submission = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": test["sample_id"]})

for col, model in preds.items():
    submission[col] = model.fit(X_train, targets[col].values).predict(X_test)

sub_long = submission.melt(id_vars="sample_id", var_name="target_name", value_name="target")
sub_long.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

print("✅ submission.csv created")
submission.head()

        img = Image.open(f"data/{img_path}").convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize((224,224))
        arr = np.expand_dims(np.array(img),0)
        return img_model.predict(arr)[0]
    except:
        return np.zeros((img_model.output_shape[-1],))

test_imgs  = np.vstack(test["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)

target_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in test.columns]

targets = train[target_cols]
# Convert to numeric to ensure targets are float values
targets = targets.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')

train = train.drop(target_cols, axis=1)

cat_cols = ["State", "Species"]

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", "passthrough", num_cols),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_cols)
])

X_train = np.hstack([train_imgs, train[num_cols].values])
X_test  = np.hstack([test_imgs, test[num_cols].values])

X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, targets.values, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

preds = {}
for i, col in enumerate(targets.columns):
    model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:,i])
    vpred = model.predict(X_val)
    print(f"{col} R2:", r2_score(y_val[:,i], vpred))
    preds[col] = model

submission = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": test["sample_id"]})

for col, model in preds.items():
    submission[col] = model.fit(X_train, targets[col].values).predict(X_test)

sub_long = submission.melt(id_vars="sample_id", var_name="target_name", value_name="target")
sub_long.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

print("✅ submission.csv created")

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.applications import EfficientNetB0
from tensorflow.keras.applications.efficientnet import preprocess_input
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model

train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

base_model = EfficientNetB0(weights="imagenet", include_top=False, pooling="avg")
inp = tf.keras.Input(shape=(224,224,3))
x = preprocess_input(inp)
out = base_model(x)
img_model = Model(inp, out)

def extract_features(img_path):
    try:
        img = Image.open(f"data/{img_path}").convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize((224,224))
        arr = np.expand_dims(np.array(img),0)
        return img_model.predict(arr)[0]
    except:
        return np.zeros((img_model.output_shape[-1],))

train_imgs = np.vstack(train["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)
test_imgs  = np.vstack(test["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)

# Detect target columns from train data - look for columns present in train but not in test
target_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in test.columns]
print(f"Target columns found: {target_cols}")

targets = train[target_cols].astype(float)  # Ensure targets are numeric
train = train.drop(target_cols, axis=1)

# Detect numerical columns (select only numeric columns, excluding categorical and ID columns)
num_cols = train.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
num_cols = [col for col in num_cols if col not in ["image_path", "sample_id"]]
print(f"Numerical columns found: {num_cols}")

cat_cols = ["State", "Species"]

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", "passthrough", num_cols),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_cols)
])

# Use preprocessor to transform categorical columns
train_processed = preprocessor.fit_transform(train[num_cols + cat_cols])
test_processed = preprocessor.transform(test[num_cols + cat_cols])

X_train = np.hstack([train_imgs, train_processed])
X_test  = np.hstack([test_imgs, test_processed])

X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, targets.values, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

preds = {}
for i, col in enumerate(targets.columns):
    model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:,i])
    vpred = model.predict(X_val)
    print(f"{col} R2:", r2_score(y_val[:,i], vpred))
    preds[col] = model

submission = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": test["sample_id"]})

for col, model in preds.items():
    submission[col] = model.fit(X_train, targets[col].values).predict(X_test)

sub_long = submission.melt(id_vars="sample_id", var_name="target_name", value_name="target")
sub_long.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

print("✅ submission.csv created")
submission.head()

cat_cols_candidate = ["State", "Species"]
